e.title: riskscores (R)
e.summary: 优化整数风险评分模型 R 包（Brown 团队）：稀疏+整数约束直接进拟合，评分卡新范式
e.body: riskscores 实现优化的风险评分模型学习（v1.3.0，Brown 大学团队）：把稀疏性与整数约束直接集成进模型拟合过程——输出可直接用于生产的小整数分（如 0-100 风险分），替代传统评分卡的离散化/人工切分步骤。对保险与信贷风险评分（承保风险分、理赔风险分、健康风险分）是现代方法。与 [[scorecardpy]]（传统评分卡流水线）互补——一个是经典流程，一个是优化方法。关联 [[insurance-credibility]]（信度）、[[insurance-thin-data]]（薄数据定价）、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v1.3.0，Brown 大学（Eglinton/Tang/Paul/Yan），稀疏+整数约束风险评分模型优化（cv_risk_mod 基于 glm.fit 修改）
e.summary_en: R package for optimized integer risk-score models (Brown University): sparsity and integer constraints integrated into model fitting
e.summary_hk: 優化整數風險評分模型 R 包（Brown 團隊）：稀疏+整數約束直接進擬合，評分卡新範式
e.body_en: riskscores implements an optimized approach to learning risk-score models (v1.3.0, Brown University team): sparsity and integer constraints are integrated directly into the model-fitting process — producing small production-ready integer scores (e.g. 0-100 risk points) and replacing the discretization/manual-binning steps of traditional scorecards. For insurance and credit risk scoring (underwriting risk scores, claims risk scores, health risk scores) it is the modern approach. Complements [[scorecardpy]] (classical scorecard pipeline) — one is the classic flow, the other the optimization method. Related: [[insurance-credibility]] (credibility), [[insurance-thin-data]] (thin-data pricing), [[actuarial-pricing]], [[machine-learning-pricing]].
e.body_hk: riskscores 實現優化的風險評分模型學習（v1.3.0，Brown 大學團隊）：把稀疏性與整數約束直接集成進模型擬合過程——輸出可直接用於生產的小整數分（如 0-100 風險分），替代傳統評分卡的離散化/人工切分步驟。對保險與信貸風險評分（承保風險分、理賠風險分、健康風險分）是現代方法。與 [[scorecardpy]]（傳統評分卡流水線）互補——一個是經典流程，一個是優化方法。關聯 [[insurance-credibility]]（信度）、[[insurance-thin-data]]（薄數據定價）、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。
